quote: Morning air! If men will not drink of this at the fountain-head of the day, why, then, we must even bottle up some and sell it in the shops
meaning: Fresh morning air is a gift. Wake early and breathe it in while it is free.

quote: 5 minutes a day of long, slow out-breaths lifted mood more than meditation did.
meaning: You don't need an hour. Five minutes of slow breathing out goes everywhere with you.

quote: 12 studies, 785 adults: breathing practice lowered stress.
meaning: It helped by a small to medium amount. Not magic, but real.

quote: We begin by controlling the breath, as the easiest way of getting control of the Prana.
meaning: Your breath is the easiest door to your life energy. Learn to guide your breath first.

quote: 13 studies: yoga lowered depression in people with mental health problems. More classes a week, bigger drops.
meaning: Showing up often may matter most.

quote: 22 studies: adults with poor sleep who did yoga said they slept almost 2 hours more a night.
meaning: A gentle, cheap way to help sleep. Use it next to your doctor's advice.

quote: When one gives undivided attention to the (vital) breath, and brings it to the utmost degree of pliancy, he can become as a (tender) babe.
meaning: Give your full attention to your breath and keep it soft. Then you stay fresh and bendy like a baby.

quote: 118 adults, average age 62: 8 weeks of yoga beat stretching on memory and focus tests.
meaning: Starting in your 60s still counts. Yoga helped the mind, not only the body.

quote: Health is the greatest of gifts, contentedness the best riches...
meaning: Being healthy is the best gift. Being happy with what you have is real treasure.
